keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Brest 1, Angers 0. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Hugo Magnetti with a cross.
Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Brest 2, Angers 0. Lucas Tousart (Brest) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Joris Chotard with a cross.
Goal! Brest 3, Angers 0. Kenny Lala (Brest) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Angers. Emmanuel Biumla replaces Ousmane Camara because of an injury.
